definition: the liquid fuel that runs car engines
description: A young man in a plaid shirt with a headlamp on his forehead crouches on a wooden porch at dusk after a storm, with a fallen tree in the yard behind. He pours gasoline from a red metal jerry can through a white funnel into a small portable generator. A lit oil lantern stands beside the generator, and a wrench and a coiled cable lie on the damp boards. A woman holding a torch watches from a window. He then stops pouring, lifts the can upright and turns to smile at her.

taps.phrase: to peer out of a window
